_comment: Pterodactyl Egg for a self-hosted Docker Registry
name: Docker Registry
author: dontmailme.output543@passinbox.com
description: Runs a Docker Registry (distribution) inside Pterodactyl.

installation.script:
#!/bin/ash
# Docker Registry: no install step required.
# Server files live in /home/container (mapped from /mnt/server).
# The entrypoint.sh is baked into the image at /usr/local/bin/entrypoint.sh
mkdir -p /mnt/server/registry
echo 'Installation complete. Registry data will be stored in /home/container/registry'

variables.name: Registry Log Level
variables.description: Log level for the registry (error, warn, info, debug).

variables.name: Registry Data Directory
variables.description: Path the registry will use to store image data.

variables.name: Registry Auth Username
variables.description: Username for registry authentication. Leave empty to disable auth (public access).

variables.name: Registry Auth Password
variables.description: Password for registry authentication. Required if username is set.
